next:wr:234.hint: 犬が哺乳類であるのと同様、コウモリも哺乳類だ
next:wr:234.answer: A bat is no less a mammal than a dog is.
next:wr:234.fullSentence: A bat is no less a mammal than a dog is.
next:wr:234.explanation: no less A than B。クジラ構文の逆で、両方とも同程度に肯定される。
next:wr:234.relatedInfo: no more A than B(否定)との対比。

next:wr:236.hint: 幸せな結婚にはお金も愛と同様に必要だ
next:wr:236.answer: Money is no less necessary for a happy marriage than love is.
next:wr:236.fullSentence: Money is no less necessary for a happy marriage than love is.
next:wr:236.relatedInfo: no more...than(否定)の逆で肯定的な同等比較。

next:wr:238.answer: I have not less than five dollars.
next:wr:238.fullSentence: I have not less than five dollars.
next:wr:238.explanation: not less than = at least『少なくとも』。
next:wr:238.relatedInfo: not more than(多くても)との対比。

next:wr:240.answer: I have no less than five dollars.
next:wr:240.fullSentence: I have no less than five dollars.
next:wr:240.explanation: no less than = as much/many as『〜も』。
next:wr:240.relatedInfo: 多さを強調するニュアンス。

next:wr:242.hint: 彼はその3人の少年の中で一番速く走れる
next:wr:242.answer: He can run the fastest of the three boys.
next:wr:242.fullSentence: He can run the fastest of the three boys.
next:wr:242.explanation: the+最上級+of+複数(比較対象の集団)。
next:wr:242.relatedInfo: in+単数集合名詞との使い分け。

next:wr:244.hint: その映画は断然すべての中で一番面白い
next:wr:244.answer: The movie is by far the most interesting of all.
next:wr:244.fullSentence: The movie is by far the most interesting of all.
next:wr:244.explanation: 最上級の強調はby far, much, far, very, the veryを使う。
next:wr:244.relatedInfo: by farは最上級を強調する代表的な語句。

next:wr:246.hint: 私はせいぜいかばんを3つしか運べない
next:wr:246.answer: I can carry at most three bags.
next:wr:246.fullSentence: I can carry at most three bags.
next:wr:246.explanation: at most=多くても(=not more than)。
next:wr:246.relatedInfo: at least(少なくとも)との対比。

next:wr:248.hint: 今朝はコーヒーよりむしろ紅茶が飲みたい
next:wr:248.answer: I'd like tea rather than coffee this morning.
next:wr:248.fullSentence: I'd like tea rather than coffee this morning.
next:wr:248.explanation: rather than A『Aよりむしろ』。比較級を用いた慣用表現。
next:wr:248.relatedInfo: B rather than A『AよりむしろB』の形でよく使う。

next:wr:250.hint: 彼は彼女を信用するほど馬鹿ではなかったはずなのに
next:wr:250.answer: He should have known better than to trust her.
next:wr:250.fullSentence: He should have known better than to trust her.
next:wr:250.explanation: should have known better than to do『〜するほど馬鹿ではなかったのに(実際はしてしまった)』。
next:wr:250.relatedInfo: know better than to doの過去の後悔形。

next:wr:252.hint: この車は燃費であの車より優れている
next:wr:252.answer: This car is superior to that one in fuel efficiency.
next:wr:252.fullSentence: This car is superior to that one in fuel efficiency.
next:wr:252.explanation: be superior to B『Bより優れている』。比較対象にthanでなくtoを使う形容詞群の一つ。
next:wr:252.relatedInfo: be inferior to B(劣っている)がその反対。

next:wr:254.hint: 彼女は会社で彼より後輩だ
next:wr:254.answer: She is junior to him in the company.
next:wr:254.fullSentence: She is junior to him in the company.
next:wr:254.explanation: be junior to B『Bより年下だ、後輩だ』。
next:wr:254.relatedInfo: be senior to B(先輩)がその反対。

next:wr:256.hint: 私は紅茶よりコーヒーの方が好きだ
next:wr:256.explanation: prefer A to B『BよりAを好む』。
next:wr:256.relatedInfo: than ではなくtoを使う点に注意。

next:wr:258.hint: 日本の他のどの山も富士山ほど高くない(＝富士山が一番高い)
next:wr:258.answer: No other mountain in Japan is as high as Mt. Fuji.
next:wr:258.fullSentence: No other mountain in Japan is as high as Mt. Fuji.
next:wr:258.explanation: No other A is as 原級 as B『Aで(Bほど)〜なものはない』(最上級の意味を持つ原級比較)。
next:wr:258.relatedInfo: Mt. Fuji is the highest mountain in Japan. と同義。

next:wr:260.hint: 富士山は日本の他のどの山よりも高い
next:wr:260.answer: Mt. Fuji is higher than any other mountain in Japan.
next:wr:260.fullSentence: Mt. Fuji is higher than any other mountain in Japan.
next:wr:260.explanation: 比較級+than any other+単数名詞『他のどの…よりも〜』(最上級の意味を持つ比較級)。
next:wr:260.relatedInfo: 最上級を比較級で言い換える3パターンの一つ。

next:wr:262.hint: 時間より貴重なものはない
next:wr:262.answer: Nothing is more precious than time.
next:wr:262.fullSentence: Nothing is more precious than time.
next:wr:262.explanation: Nothing is 比較級 than A『Aより〜なものはない』(最上級の意味を持つ比較級)。
next:wr:262.relatedInfo: Nothing is as precious as time. と同義。

next:wr:264.hint: シェフとしての彼の腕は誰にも劣らない、一番だ
next:wr:264.answer: His skill as a chef is second to none.
next:wr:264.fullSentence: His skill as a chef is second to none.
next:wr:264.explanation: second to none『誰にも(何にも)劣らない、一番だ』。
next:wr:264.relatedInfo: 最上級に匹敵する意味を持つ慣用句。

next:wr:266.hint: 最も重要なのはお金ではなく幸福だ
next:wr:266.answer: It is not money but happiness that matters most.
next:wr:266.fullSentence: It is not money but happiness that matters most.
next:wr:266.explanation: It is not A but B that ~『〜なのはAではなくBだ』(強調構文の否定・肯定対比パターン)。
next:wr:266.relatedInfo: not A but Bの強調構文バージョン。

next:wr:268.hint: 勝ったのはジョンだ、トムではない
next:wr:268.answer: It is John that won, not Tom.
next:wr:268.fullSentence: It is John that won, not Tom.
next:wr:268.explanation: It is B that ~, not A『〜なのはB、Aではない』。
next:wr:268.relatedInfo: 強調構文It is ~ that の後にnot Aを添えて対比する。

next:wr:270.hint: 彼を成功させたのは才能というよりむしろ努力だ
next:wr:270.answer: It is not so much his talent as his effort that made him successful.
next:wr:270.fullSentence: It is not so much his talent as his effort that made him successful.
next:wr:270.explanation: It is not so much A that ~ as B『〜なのはAというよりむしろBだ』。
next:wr:270.relatedInfo: not so much A as Bの強調構文バージョン。

next:wr:272.hint: まもなく彼は戻ってくるだろう
next:wr:272.answer: It will not be long before he comes back.
next:wr:272.fullSentence: It will not be long before he comes back.
next:wr:272.explanation: It will not be long before S+V『まもなく〜するだろう』。
next:wr:272.relatedInfo: beforeの後は未来のことでも現在形になる場合が多い。

next:wr:274.hint: 彼女は毎朝運動することにしている(習慣にしている)
next:wr:274.answer: She makes it a rule to exercise every morning.
next:wr:274.fullSentence: She makes it a rule to exercise every morning.
next:wr:274.explanation: make it a rule to V『Vすることにしている』。形式目的語のit。
next:wr:274.relatedInfo: ＝make it a rule that S V。

next:wr:276.hint: 私が医者になったのは両親のおかげだ
next:wr:276.answer: I owe it to my parents that I became a doctor.
next:wr:276.fullSentence: I owe it to my parents that I became a doctor.
next:wr:276.explanation: S owe it to A that ~『〜なのはAのおかげだ』。形式目的語のit。

next:wr:278.hint: 早めに返信していただければ幸いです
next:wr:278.answer: I would appreciate it if you could reply soon.
next:wr:278.fullSentence: I would appreciate it if you could reply soon.
next:wr:278.explanation: I would appreciate it if you could ~『〜していただければ幸いです』。形式目的語のit。
next:wr:278.relatedInfo: 依頼のメールなどでよく使われる丁寧表現。

next:wr:280.answer: I still use this old camera of mine.
next:wr:280.fullSentence: I still use this old camera of mine.
next:wr:280.explanation: this old camera of mine『私のこの古いカメラ』(二重所有格)。thisとmyを同時に使えないためofを使う。
next:wr:280.relatedInfo: a friend of mine と同じ二重所有格の構造。

next:wr:282.hint: あなたは私に賛成なのだと思う
next:wr:282.answer: I take it that you agree with me.
next:wr:282.fullSentence: I take it that you agree with me.
next:wr:282.explanation: take it that ~『〜だと思う、〜だと理解する』。形式目的語のit。
next:wr:282.relatedInfo: I suppose that ~ に近いニュアンス。
